title: Client Update Reminder
description: Manage supported version ranges for each client type. A client type without a policy is not checked.

settings.title: Update Reminder Settings
settings.description: The global switch pauses or resumes all configured client version policies.

distribution.title: Client Version Policies
distribution.description: Shows recognized clients active in the past 7 days, their policy, and its effective supported range.

empty.title: No client data available
empty.description: No recognizable clients have been active in the past 7 days.

toggle.description: Pausing checks preserves every configured policy and its baseline history.
toggle.toggleFailed: Could not update client version checks

state.preview: Policies are shown as a preview while checks are paused.

actions.failed: Could not save the client version policy

validation.invalid: Enter a valid X.Y.Z version and policy value.

deleteDialog.title: Delete client version policy?
deleteDialog.description: {clientType} will no longer have a client version check.
